# Icarus

> Icarus is a free, open-source diary app (GNU GPL v3). Entries can be encrypted with a password, are stored only on the user's device in a standard iCalendar (.ics) file, and can be browsed and searched across many years without delay.

Icarus runs as a desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux, and as a web app in the browser. There is no account, server-side storage, sync service or tracking: the desktop app saves the diary in a folder the user chooses, and the web app keeps it in the browser's IndexedDB.

## Product

- [Icarus overview](https://icarus.4oli.com/index.md): Concise product facts, privacy model, and suitable use cases, in Markdown.
- [Icarus home page](https://icarus.4oli.com/): Product page with download and web app links.
- [Download Icarus](https://icarus.4oli.com/download): Desktop builds for Windows, macOS and Linux, with first-launch steps and SHA-256 checksums.
- [Icarus web app](https://icarus.4oli.com/app/): The diary in the browser. Data stays in that browser.
